svg.aria-label: Security design. Defense in depth, four layers from the outside in. 1. Internet (untrusted): No inbound connections are allowed in. 2. Perimeter (filtered): ISR 4331 and OPNsense with Suricata IDS filter and inspect all traffic. 3. Internal network (segmented): Six VLANs, isolated by access lists on the core switch. 4. Management access (restricted): Switch and router logins only from the admin workstation. Who can talk to who; every rule works in both directions. Management (VLAN 10, Admin PC, switches, APs, Proxmox): Internet allowed; Internal allowed; Servers allowed; Storage allowed for Admin PC, Proxmox only; Cameras allowed for Admin PC only; Guests blocked; rule Admin-SSH. Internal (VLAN 20, Family PCs and phones, Wi-Fi): Internet allowed; Management allowed; Servers allowed; Storage blocked; Cameras blocked; Guests blocked; no rule of its own. Servers (VLAN 40, DCs, file server, monitoring): Internet allowed; Management allowed; Internal allowed; Storage allowed; Cameras blocked; Guests blocked; no rule of its own. Storage (VLAN 60, UniFi UNAS Pro): Internet allowed; Management allowed for Admin PC, Proxmox only; Internal blocked; Servers allowed; Cameras blocked; Guests blocked; rule NAS. Cameras (VLAN 50, 4 PoE cameras and the NVR): Internet blocked; Management allowed for Admin PC only; Internal blocked; Servers blocked; Storage blocked; Guests blocked; rule IP-Cameras. Guests (VLAN 30, Visitor Wi-Fi): Internet allowed; Management blocked; Internal blocked; Servers blocked; Storage blocked; Cameras blocked; rule Guest-Internet.
svg.title: Security design
